title: CIA's Charles Cabell, the Dallas motorcade route and Project Blue Book
summary: Jesse Michels tells of CIA's Charles Cabell, the Dallas motorcade route and Project Blue Book, about 1950s-1963 at Dallas; Project Blue Book, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of Charles Cabell, a senior CIA officer, in an episode about a man he says turns up around many famous American suspicions, including the route of the 1963 presidential motorcade in Dallas. Michels says that Cabell had looked over Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's study of UFO reports in the 1950s and 60s, and called it a very shoddy operation, and that this is written up in a book by Edward J. Ruppelt. Michels brings it up because it would mean a top intelligence official was paying close attention to how the military handled UFOs.
